description:
Hey, I am an A-Level student with deep interest in technology, programming, game development, space exploration and physics. I love building creative projects and learning new things.

For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, I am interested in creating an interactive space survival game where players address the challenges of managing a Mars or Moon outpost.

I am looking for teammates who are willing to share new ideas, collaborate and learn together. You don't need to be expert for this project!
